top_choice_rationale: Aberration correction overcame a fundamental electron-optical limit and made atomic-scale structure and local chemistry reproducibly observable. It is a mature, discrete invention with a coherent proposed chain from correction theory to practical instruments, subject to archival confirmation of the exact allocation.
recusal_note: No direct candidate-specific conflict apparent from the profile. I work at Chalmers, as does committee colleague Göran Johansson, but no connection to the B001 candidates is identified.
